Architecture.description: The CPU's architecture (for example, x86 or ARM).

FleetName.description: The name of the fleet to which this device belongs.

AndroidPaths.description: Comma-separated list of paths on the Android device where the artifacts generated by the customer's tests are pulled from.

DeviceHostPaths.description: Comma-separated list of paths in the test execution environment where the artifacts generated by the customer's tests are pulled from.

IosPaths.description: Comma-separated list of paths on the iOS device where the artifacts generated by the customer's tests are pulled from.

Attribute.description: The aspect of a device such as platform or model used as the selection criteria in a device filter.

Operator.description: Specifies how Device Farm compares the filter's attribute to the value.

Values.description: An array of one or more filter values used in a device filter.

Port.description: The port number on which the http/s proxy is listening.

Filters.description: The filters in a device selection result.

MatchedDevicesCount.description: The number of devices that matched the device filter selection criteria.

MaxDevices.description: The maximum number of devices to be selected by a device filter and included in a test run.

Name.description: The name of the environment variable.

Value.description: The value of the environment variable.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the network profile.

Description.description: The description of the network profile.

DownlinkBandwidthBits.description: The data throughput rate in bits per second, as an integer from 0 to 104857600.

DownlinkDelayMs.description: Delay time for all packets to destination in milliseconds as an integer from 0 to 2000.

DownlinkJitterMs.description: Time variation in the delay of received packets in milliseconds as an integer from 0 to 2000.

DownlinkLossPercent.description: Proportion of received packets that fail to arrive from 0 to 100 percent.

Gps.description: True if GPS is enabled at the beginning of the test. Otherwise, false.

Nfc.description: True if NFC is enabled at the beginning of the test. Otherwise, false.

Wifi.description: True if Wi-Fi is enabled at the beginning of the test. Otherwise, false.
